summary: The prepared base already contains the issue's fix from upstream PR #33351. The former shallow update replaces text_config with a dict; the current implementation merges the nested override into the existing PretrainedConfig and preserves unmentioned fields. This PR strengthens the regression with the issue-shaped rope_parameters override and independent scalar/plain-dict boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: All five local Hugging Face loader tests passed, including the issue-shaped nested rope override, preservation of text_config fields, scalar replacement, and plain-dictionary replacement (plus two processor backend subtests).

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-8a58c3effab9/venv/bin/python reports/j-8a58c3effab9/raw reproduction snippets (captured in issue_shape_current.txt and shallow_control.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: The checked-out get_config retained a LlamaConfig with max_position_embeddings=512 and hidden_size=32 while applying the issue's rope_parameters; the former shallow-update control produced a dict and AttributeError.
The report and regression changes contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression are in CPU-only Hugging Face configuration loading. The reported two-GPU NVIDIA NVFP4 workload cannot be reproduced on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.

remaining_limitations: The reported TP=2 CUDA/RTX 5090 serving workload was not run on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.
No claim is made about NVFP4 execution, full server startup, model semantics, or distributed behavior.
